- scripts/heal_reproduce.sh:180-197 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `map_entry` returns `("not_reproduced", "passes_at_failing_sha")` when a listed `path::name` is missing from a non-empty gate `names` list, in both the failures branch (180-188) and the inherited branch (189-197). A missing name does not prove the test passed.
  WHY: `names` comes from `failing_names()`, which sees only the last `TAIL_BYTES` = 4096 bytes of output (prepush_affected_tests.py:71, 683-684), keeps at most 50 names (`unique[:50]`, line 729) and matches only `FAILED` lines (`_FAILED_RE`, line 145), so it misses `ERROR path::name` setup/teardown errors. A test that really failed can therefore be reported as `passes_at_failing_sha`. In the failures branch this turns a `reproduced`/`regression` run into `not_reproduced`, and in the inherited branch it gives wrong per-test evidence where `pre_existing` belongs. It also contradicts agents.d/heal-reproduce.md. All reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/heal_reproduce.sh:189-197 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The inherited branch labels every listed name present in an inherited unit's `names` as `not_reproduced`/`pre_existing`. The gate decides `inherited` per merged unit, not per test (classify_baseline, prepush_affected_tests.py:853-858), and `names` comes from the failing-SHA tail (line 946).
  WHY: A regression (test_x) merged into the same unit as a test that fails on both trees (test_z) gets `pre_existing` even though it passes at last green. That contradicts row 1 of the issue's mapping table. Only per-test evidence is wrong; the run-level status stays `not_reproduced`. Rated NIT.
- tests/test_heal_reproduce.py:384-395 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new test `test_named_test_absent_from_inherited_unit_names_passes` asserts that `tests/test_a.py::test_x` is `not_reproduced/passes_at_failing_sha` when `names=["tests/test_a.py::test_other"]`. That locks in the unsound absent-name mapping.
  WHY: The test is artificial: truncation cannot happen at this size, so it never separates "really passed" from "FAILED line truncated out of the tail". It cements the unsafe classification. minimax_minimax-m3 rated it MAJOR; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised it inside its MAJOR map_entry finding.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/heal_reproduce.sh:180-188 (failures branch; same pattern copied into inherited branch 189-197) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A listed `path::name` missing from a non-empty gate `names` list is treated as proof of a pass (`passes_at_failing_sha`). `failing_names()` (prepush_affected_tests.py:703-710) matches only `_FAILED_RE = r"\bFAILED\s+(\S+::\S+)"` (line 145), so `ERROR path::name` setup/teardown errors are missed. `names` is also built only from the last TAIL_BYTES=4096 (lines 71, 684).
  WHY: Trigger: test_x FAILs and test_y ERRORs in a fixture inside one merged unit, with `names=[test_x]`. test_y then maps to passes_at_failing_sha and the run becomes not_reproduced instead of reproduced, so heal intake treats a real regression as non-reproducible. Setup errors are realistic under `--network none`. Suggested fix: return ("reproduced","regression") when `f"ERROR {node}"` is in the tail; return ("unverified","names_incomplete") when the tail is near 4096; for the inherited branch, return unverified instead.
- scripts/heal_reproduce.sh:189-197 (inherited branch) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `inherited` is decided per unit (classify_baseline, prepush_affected_tests.py:853-858), and the inherited `names` comes from the failing-SHA tail (line 946). A regression test_x and a test_z that fails on both trees end up in one inherited unit, and both are labelled not_reproduced/pre_existing.
  WHY: test_x's per-test record says pre_existing although it passes at last green, which contradicts row 1 of the mapping table. The run-level status is unaffected. Suggested fix: map to ("unverified","baseline_ambiguous") when multiple listed nodes from the same file are in the unit.
- Notes on pass-1 ledger items (3 related items): it confirms openai_gpt-6-luna's finding (truncation needs a large parametrised set; FAILING_TEST_LIMIT=20 pairs, scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:3657). It judges minimax_minimax-m3's comment on test_invalid_timeout_minutes_falls_back invalid: minutes = (deadline - now - 180) // 60 gives 6, so the `[67]` regex is correct. It finds the other last-run edits correct.
- HARDENING: scripts/heal_reproduce.sh map_entry, `ran` check (line 199-200) vs whole-list `tests_file` check (lines 201-204). A line dropped by the `tests_file_too_many_entries` cap gets `passes_at_failing_sha` if another line for the same file ran; current callers cannot reach this (40 entries or fewer vs a cap of 500). Fix: move the `tests_file` loop above the `ran` check (4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
